title: SampleTone (Digitone machine)
author: x2k
description: SampleTone: a sample-playback machine for the Digitone mk1 (OS 1.44). One mono one-shot per voice with start/end (start above end plays backwards), forward loop, note pitch tracking and a tune offset, through a bit-depth/sample-rate crusher and then the Digitone's own filter, mixer, effects and AMP envelope. The Digitone has no sample engine and a machine mod cannot load a file at run time, so the samples are compiled in: bake.py converts your WAV/AIFF files into the table this machine plays. Needs the machines companion and core-dn1 4.0 for its 1.25 MB mod area.
